in_hindi.long_meaning: कड़कारा: समुंदर के साथ बितान हुए वासियों का शिरोमानी नाम

in_marathi.name: Dushyanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Warrior from heaven
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dushyanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dushyanta is a renowned king in Hindu mythology. His name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'duhs' meaning wicked and 'yanta' meaning controlled, which signifies a warrior who is in control of his wicked tendencies.
